beats.name: ast: the good citizen: straight back into the bay, nested neatly
rea: doesn't care: leaves it in the middle of the pavement, shrugs and goes back to the shop
sor: never walks to the bay: floats his trolley in, and the one left lying around
wiz: a spell to send it back multiplies it: five trolleys
dra: rides it back: comes in sitting in it, a fire-snort boost, straight into the bay
phx: close enough: leaves it by the kerb and struts off; it rolls away
gun: shoots it home: every shot knocks it closer to the bay
all: puts it back properly, then turns to you: do you?
sam: only wants his coin back: one cut at the lock, and he leaves the trolley
vik: puts it back the Viking way: rams it into the bay, and the bay is gone

title: CART: does each fighter put the trolley back?
format: each-character-vs-X, one continuous take: fighters take turns bringing a trolley back to one trolley bay, each their own way
